fieldMarks: Adults 10-15.9 cm (record 19.7 cm); tail about 60% of body length.
Ground colour yellow to orange or even red.
Vertical black bars on the sides of the tail (herringbone or 'dumbbell' look), plus dark dashes or dots on the body.
13 or 14 costal grooves; belly light yellow to cream.
Large eyes, slender body and stout limbs.
behavior: Adults migrate uphill during heavy rain and into and out of caves and mine shafts; mainly nocturnal.
Eats a wide variety of small, mainly terrestrial invertebrates.
habitat: Streamsides, spring runs, cave mouths and abandoned mines; sometimes ponds. Hides in rock crevices and under rocks, logs and debris.
range: Southern New York to Missouri, south to Arkansas, Tennessee, extreme northeastern Mississippi, northern Alabama, extreme northwestern Georgia, western North Carolina and northwestern Virginia. Not in Canada.

lookalikes.name: Three-lined salamander
lookalikes.howToTell: Three bold dark stripes along body and tail, not vertical tail bars.
